name: wgaf Window Bridge
description: Minimal GNOME Shell bridge exposing window/workspace introspection and control over D-Bus (org.gnome.Shell.Extensions.Wgaf.V1) for the wgaf automation daemon, plus the emergency key for wgaf's kill switch (Escape by default), which stops all wgaf input automation until you run `wgaf release`. No input synthesis, no accessibility calls.
